title: Warm-hit sampler elimination
motivation: F-AHL34 measured one-node sampler initialization plus bind at 1.3686e-7 s, about 18.0% of the 7.6209e-7 s complete warm changed-authority bind. That sampler is only needed to build a representation after a registry miss, but is currently constructed before every shared-registry lookup.

repair.cache_api: add read-only exact-key lookup that returns the existing immutable table on hit and does not count a miss when absent
repair.provider_path: after exact local-reuse miss and key construction, query the shared registry first; only construct/bind the one-node authoritative sampler if the registry lookup misses

correctness: warm changed-authority registry hit performs no table build and no cache miss
warm hit increments shared hit accounting exactly once
changed hydraulic authority remains exact-key separated

paired_microtiming.baseline: same candidate path plus the one-node sampler initialization/bind work removed by the repair

regression: F-AHL32A/B registry collision and probe semantics PASS
